title: Brendon Batson, part of the breakthrough.
deck: The full-back in an adventurous Albion side.
body: Brendon Batson followed Ron Atkinson from Cambridge United to Albion in 1978. The club’s retrospective describes how he and Derek Statham, on the opposite flank, were encouraged to overlap and support the attack.

Alongside Cyrille Regis and Laurie Cunningham, he became part of a group whose prominence challenged assumptions about Black footballers. Remembering him only through that shared legacy misses the player: a key defender in a side committed to going forward. Injury eventually cut short his playing career.
